Gather.Say: Thank you for calling Monk's Café.
To reserve a table for tonight, press the number of people in your party, from 1 to 8. Then press 1 for 6 p.m., 2 for 7 p.m., or 3 for 8 p.m.
For example, for four people at 7 p.m., press 4, then 2.

Response.Say: We did not receive a reservation. Goodbye.
